data.notes: Predecessors: Q3 8U (2011-2018), Q5 8R (2008-2017). No earlier Q3/Q5 generation existed. No PHEV in these generations; Q5 8R had a full hybrid with reduced trunk.

verification.notes: Q3 8U: angurten.de (https://www.angurten.de/is/abmessungen/1237-Q3) confirms 4385/1831/2603 mm, 460/1365 l; it lists height 1608 mm and autozine.nl gives 160 cm, but the official Audi UK sheet gives 1590 mm (likely without roof rails), so no correction under the manufacturer-first rule. The facelift's 4388 mm (auto-data, meinestadt) is consistent with the given note. RS Q3: ADAC confirms 4410 mm and 356/1261 l; 1841/1580 mm confirmed for the RS Q3 performance by autoplenum. Q5 8R: angurten.de (https://www.angurten.de/is/abmessungen/1218-Q5) confirms 4629/1880/1653/2807 mm and 540 l; ADAC/encycarpedia confirm 540/1560 l. Q5 hybrid 460/1480 l confirmed by motor1/autoplenum/ADAC (kfz-tech lists width 1898 mm for the hybrid, not an official figure). SQ5 TDI 540/1560 l confirmed; dimension conflict (ams 4644x1911x1624 vs ADAC/angurten 4629x1880x1653) persists, so leaving the per-variant dimensions null is reasonable. No missing German-market variants found (SQ5 3.0 TFSI was not sold in Germany; RS Q3 performance is covered in the notes).
